edits.headline: Trump announces $8 billion fuel relief programme for US farmers
edits.subheadline: The US Department of Agriculture will run the programme to help farmers offset diesel costs at harvest, FOX 35 Orlando reported.
editorialBody: President Donald Trump said the US Department of Agriculture would launch an $8 billion harvest fuel relief programme to help farmers offset diesel costs, FOX 35 Orlando reported.
In Canada, a grass fire driven by strong winds killed four soldiers at a military base, Daily Maverick reported. The fire was at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright in Alberta, Al Jazeera reported.
France announced nightly curfews in Paris and other big cities for as long as necessary, the Associated Press reported.
Delhi announced winter pollution curbs under which vehicles without a valid pollution certificate will be refused fuel, Outlook India reported.

Reliance's Jio Platforms drew about $25 billion in bids from anchor investors for its $3.2 billion share sale, The Star reported, citing Reuters. The company raised about 8,110 crore rupees from more than 200 anchor investors, Business Today reported.
